positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a backend developer for an enterprise-scale machine learning application in the user identity and access management space. Experienced with Python, relational databases (Postgres), graph database technologies (AWS Neptune) and many other AWS products. Helped build and design a serverless microservice-based architecture.

Designed and built an API orchestration engine, merging multiple separate services.

Served as a mentor to Capital One interns.

Worked with campus recruiting to attend Duke events.
